rca_of_the_issue: User complaint root cause: freebuild_agent.py had 5 internal guard rails (DESIGN-DESTRUCTION GUARD, SURGICAL-EDIT GUARD, SURGICAL-HARDBLOCK, DESIGN_PRESERVATION, DESIGN_LOCKED, plus INTENT_LOCK._blocked_tools) that were too aggressive — they returned tool_result errors and removed tools from the toolset BEFORE the AI ever got a chance to call them, even on legitimate first-design or surgical edits. The fix converts all five to `logger.info` advisories: dispatcher proceeds, the model gets the tool result it expected, and the advisory is captured in logs for observability. Behaviour preserved: (a) BLANK PAGE DETECTOR still injects a warning into the AI message stream when a page falls below 800 chars / 1 section; (b) PRE-FINISH GATE still rejects `finish` calls when pages are blank and sets force_tool_use_next_iter=True; (c) lying_guard still appends a one-shot reminder when the user asks for an action but the assistant returns no tool_use block. All three guarantees are verified in test_blockers_relaxed.py::TestEssentialRulesPreserved (3/3) and test_pre_finish_gate.py (6/6). The only test-suite cleanup needed is the one inverted assertion in test_surgical_fixes_v2.py.
